name: antigravity-workflow-workspace
description: AntiGravity Issue & Task Workflow Integrated Workspace

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix workflow_server && npm install --prefix workflow_react
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "cyan.bold,green.bold" "npm run dev --prefix workflow_server" "npm run dev --prefix workflow_react"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix workflow_server && npm run build --prefix workflow_react
scripts.electron: concurrently -k -n "SERVER,ELECTRON" -c "cyan.bold,yellow.bold" "npm run dev --prefix workflow_server" "npm run electron:dev --prefix workflow_react"
